newsitem.title: USA: P&O Steam Navigation sells $500 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: P&O Steam Navigation sells $500 mln in debt.

text.p: The following two-part 144A private placement from Peninsular & Oriental Steam Navigation Co was priced in the U.S. on Thursday via J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, according to a market source.
